question: How is the yogini named Iccha connected to the siddhas and supreme will?
premises: A yogini named Iccha is identified
The scope reaches up to maya by supreme will
inference: The yogini Iccha is linked with the siddhas and operates up to maya by supreme will.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between siddhaiḥ and māyāntaṃ is compressed.
plain_english: The yogini named Iccha, with the siddhas, extends up to maya by the supreme will.
